brands.name: Amouage
brands.blurb: Founded in 1983 by royal decree in Muscat, Amouage composes at the highest concentrations in perfumery. Its Exceptional Extraits and attars are the reference for modern Arabian luxury.

brands.name: Parfums de Marly
brands.blurb: Inspired by the equestrian culture of the court of Louis XV, Parfums de Marly is the house behind Layton, Delina and Althaïr — some of the most requested fragrances in East Africa today.

brands.name: Nishane
brands.blurb: Nishane bottles Istanbul’s dual soul: Ottoman opulence and modern minimalism, always as extrait de parfum. Hacivat and Ani are cult objects among collectors.

brands.name: Roja Parfums
brands.blurb: Roja Dove’s London house is unapologetically opulent — hand-finished bottles, Swarovski-set caps and formulas built on the world’s rarest raw materials.

brands.name: Mancera
brands.blurb: Pierre Montale’s sister house delivers the performance our customers ask for first: dense, long-lasting compositions that hold up in Mombasa heat and Kigali evenings alike.

brands.name: Xerjoff Casamorati
brands.blurb: Xerjoff resurrected the historic Casamorati house of Bologna. The tasselled, hand-decorated bottles hold rich, romantic compositions with an old-world Italian heart.

brands.name: Goldfield & Banks
brands.blurb: Built on native Australian botanicals — sandalwood, finger lime, Tasmanian pepper — Goldfield & Banks makes bright, botanical perfumes that feel made for East African sunshine.

brands.name: Initio Parfums Privés
brands.blurb: Initio designs fragrance around the science of attraction — musks, ouds and absolutes engineered to leave a trail. Oud for Greatness is one of the most re-ordered bottles we carry.

brands.name: Montale
brands.tagline: Paris meets the Arabian oud tradition
brands.blurb: Pierre Montale spent years composing for the royal families of the Gulf before returning to Paris. His aluminium bottles guard some of the most beloved oud and rose compositions in the world.

brands.name: Afnan
brands.blurb: Afnan proves that Arabian craft and accessible pricing belong together. 9PM and Supremacy are gateway fragrances for a generation of East African collectors.

brands.name: Ajmal
brands.blurb: Founded in 1951, Ajmal is one of the great Arabian houses — from pure dahn al oudh to modern sprays like Amber Wood and Aristocrat, all made in its own Dubai facilities.

products.name: Interlude Man
products.description: The beast of Muscat: a storm of incense, smoke and resin that resolves into calm. Twelve hours later it is still speaking.

products.name: Reflection Man
products.description: A powdery iris tailored like a white shirt. The office fragrance for men who never raise their voice.

products.name: Guidance
products.description: Quentin Bisch’s modern Amouage: rose and pear lifted by frankincense into something quietly luminous.

products.name: Jubilation XXV Man
products.description: Created for the house’s 25th anniversary — a fruity, honeyed oud that smells like a celebration in a palace courtyard.

products.name: Honour Woman
products.description: A white-floral tragedy inspired by Madame Butterfly. Tuberose and gardenia with a heartbeat of leather underneath.

products.name: Oud Ulya
products.description: A 12ml attar of pure Assam oud, sublimed with birch tar and softened by vanilla. Two drops on the wrist last a full day.

products.name: Rose Aqor
products.description: Roses from the oasis of Al Aqor, held in frankincense and sandalwood. The attar tradition at its most refined.

products.name: Epic Man
products.description: The Silk Road in a bottle: spiced tea, incense and oud crossing from China to Arabia.

products.name: Layton
products.description: The most requested bottle in our Nairobi showroom. Crisp apple and lavender melting into warm vanilla — a compliment machine.

products.name: Delina
products.description: A lychee-drenched rose in the softest pink. Delina is the modern feminine signature, wildly generous and unmistakable.

products.name: Herod
products.description: Sweet tobacco, cinnamon and vanilla wrapped around a cigar-lounge warmth. The cold-evening choice for Nairobi and Kigali.

products.name: Pegasus
products.description: Almond and vanilla in a plush, powdery cloud. Pegasus is the soft-spoken member of the Marly stable.

products.name: Althaïr
products.description: Bourbon vanilla, praline and orange blossom — the newest Marly icon and already a waiting-list item across our five markets.

products.name: Valaya
products.description: A veil of clean linen: musky, airy white flowers. The scent of a freshly pressed shirt on a bright Kampala morning.

products.name: Carlisle
products.description: Apple and tonka over a deep patchouli base. The plush, intense sibling of Layton in the 125ml royal-blue flacon.

products.name: Percival
products.description: Bright, lavender-led freshness with a tonka sweetness. Percival is the daytime everyman of the Marly range.

products.name: Hacivat
products.description: Pineapple and bergamot over a sharp mossy-woody base — the extrait that made Nishane a cult name. Bright, bold, endlessly complimented.

products.name: Ani
products.description: Ginger, rose and a wave of vanilla — named after the ruined medieval city. Warm, sweet and impossibly long-lasting.

products.name: Fan Your Flames
products.description: Rum, coconut and tobacco: a tropical night in a cigar lounge. The sweet, boozy showstopper.

products.name: Hundred Silent Ways
products.description: Creamy tuberose and peach over vanilla. Inspired by Rumi, worn like a secret.

products.name: Wulong Cha
products.description: Oolong tea and citrus with a whisper of fig. The freshest Nishane — perfect for coastal humidity.

products.name: Hacivat X
products.description: The X Collection reinterpretation: Hacivat’s fruit lifted by incense and a mineral musk. Same bones, sharper tailoring.

products.name: Suède et Safran
products.description: Saffron threads pressed into soft suede. Spicy, leathery and quietly expensive.

products.name: Elysium Pour Homme
products.description: The Roja everyone knows: a heroic citrus-fresh cologne built on the finest ambergris and musk. Clean, radiant, expensive.

products.name: Enigma Pour Homme
products.description: Cognac, tobacco and vanilla — a fragrance that transforms whoever wears it into a man of intrigue.

products.name: Danger Pour Femme
products.description: A ruby-red rose with a warning label. Roja’s most seductive feminine, dangerous for everyone who catches its trail.

products.name: Oceania
products.description: The infinity of the ocean: sparkling citrus drifting over sandalwood and moss. Summer, bottled with Roja precision.

products.name: Burlington 1819
products.description: A tribute to London’s Burlington Arcade — cinnamon, rose and a glowing golden vanilla base.

products.name: Apex Pour Homme
products.description: A fresh, fruity chypre for the man at the top of the food chain — pineapple, pink pepper and a mossy leather base.

products.name: Elysium Pour Femme
products.description: A refreshingly sweet floral with the energy of a heroine forging her own path. Bright, generous, sun-drenched.

products.name: Sweetie Aoud
products.description: Butter, caramel and toasted almond drifting through a palace kitchen — while agarwood and frankincense burn in the courtyard.

products.name: Enigma Aoud
products.description: Enigma’s cognac-and-tobacco heart meets a sea of Arabian sandalwood and oud. Roja’s tribute to the Gulf.

products.name: Cedrat Boise
products.description: Citrus and blackcurrant crackling over a leathery vanilla base — twelve-hour longevity in a fresh fragrance. Our best-selling Mancera.

products.name: Red Tobacco
products.description: Cuban tobacco, saffron and oud in a heat wave of a fragrance. Potent, warm and unforgettable.

products.name: Roses Vanille
products.description: Rose petals rolled in sugar and vanilla. The sweetest floral gourmand we stock, and a wedding-season favourite.

products.name: Instant Crush
products.description: Rose, jasmine and amber in a rich romantic mix — sensual from the first spray.

products.name: Black Gold
products.description: Freshness and strength united: aromatic lavender over dark woods and leather, in the black-and-gold flacon.

products.name: Aoud Lemon Mint
products.description: A Cuban mojito poured over Arabian oud. Fresh, sweet and surprising.

products.name: Coco Vanille
products.description: Sweet and innocent, yet dangerous and seductive — coconut and vanilla with a jasmine heart.

products.name: Hindu Kush
products.description: A resinous, incense-laden ascent through the mountain range that divides heaven and earth.
A woody-amber homage to the house’s founding year: warm, spicy, quietly animalic. The most masculine Casamorati.

products.name: Mefisto
products.description: A gentleman’s citrus from the turn of the 20th century, reborn — lavender, iris and clean woods in the pale-blue tasselled flacon.

products.name: Lira
products.description: Caramel, blood orange and cinnamon — the Italian gelato of fragrances, and a perennial best-seller for good reason.

products.name: Bouquet Ideale
products.description: The bridge between old and new Casamorati: almond and rose in a spiced vanilla — the deep-red bottle with the golden tassel.

products.name: Dolce Amalfi
products.description: The Amalfi Coast at golden hour: sunny citrus warmed by cinnamon and vanilla.

products.name: Fiero
products.description: La sprezzatura italiana — effortless style in an emerald flacon. Aromatic, woody and dignified.

products.name: Dama Bianca
products.description: A manicured spring garden under cotton-cloud skies: soft white florals in the ivory bottle.

products.name: Gran Ballo
products.description: The innocence of first love at a grand ballroom — a waltz of rose, peony and musk in a fuchsia flacon.

products.name: Pacific Rock Moss
products.description: Sea spray on sun-warmed rocks along Australia’s south coast. The definitive aromatic-aquatic, and a Mombasa favourite.

products.name: Wood Infusion
products.description: Australian exotic woods with sandalwood album and a hint of agarwood — the rainforest of K’gari, distilled.

products.name: Blue Cypress
products.description: Morning light burning mist off the Kakadu: blue cypress, cardamom and clean cedar.

products.name: Bohemian Lime
products.description: Byron Bay in a bottle: native finger lime and coriander softening into vetiver. Radiant and effortless.

products.name: Silky Woods
products.description: Australian agarwood wrapped in cinnamon and vanilla — a woody gourmand as smooth as its name.

products.name: Velvet Splendour
products.description: Pressing your face into a bouquet of sunburnt wildflowers — mimosa, violet and a chypre finish.

products.name: Oud for Greatness
products.description: Saffron, nutmeg and lavender on a bed of dense oud. The niche oud that made East Africa fall in love with Initio.

products.name: Side Effect
products.description: Rum, tobacco and vanilla with a saffron sting — a night out you will want to repeat.

products.name: Musk Therapy
products.description: Creamy sandalwood fused with white and pink musks — an olfactory therapy session in a white bottle.

products.name: Rehab
products.description: A sensory sanctuary: sparkling bergamot and black pepper over soothing sage and sandalwood.

products.name: Atomic Rose
products.description: A full, bare rose scarcely dressed with jasmine and vanilla. So desirable it makes you blush.

products.name: Oud for Happiness
products.description: Oud redefined with a puff of freshly cut grass — a modern portal to joy.

products.name: Paragon
products.description: Palo santo and white sage — sacred woods burned in a modern temple. Smoky, meditative, magnetic.

products.name: Blessed Baraka
products.description: White flowers and grounding sandalwood — a source of power, an embodiment of blessing.

products.name: Intense Cafe
products.description: Velvety rose meets sensual coffee in a trail known worldwide. The Montale we can never keep in stock.

products.name: Arabians Tonka
products.description: Oud, leather and sweet tonka — the Arabians collection at its most gourmand and most beloved.

products.name: Roses Musk
products.description: Pure, vibrant rose melting into precious musk. The iconic Montale floral, unmistakable at ten paces.

products.name: Oud Tobacco
products.description: A suave, mysterious tonka-tobacco accord inflamed by cumin and red sumac, with incense and oud beneath.

products.name: Starry Nights
products.description: Like stardust on the skin — Calabrian bergamot leading to Bulgarian rose, Egyptian jasmine and white musk.

products.name: Black Aoud
products.description: Montale’s emblem: majestic Cambodian oud with Indonesian patchouli, roses and musk. The oud that started a movement.

products.name: Chocolate Greedy
products.description: Roasted tonka, candied orange and vanilla — the comfort of childhood in a silver bottle.

products.name: Dark Vanilla
products.description: A dark, carnal vanilla underlined by amber, leather and oud. Intimate and magnetic.

products.name: 9PM
products.description: The fragrance that launched a thousand compliments. Apple, cinnamon and vanilla in the sleek black bottle — our #1 seller under KES 10,000.

products.name: 9PM Pour Femme
products.description: A bold woody-floral in violet: tart fruit, powdery iris and a vanilla trail. The evening companion to 9PM.

products.name: 9AM Dive
products.description: A brisk morning plunge into crystal water — salty, minty and clean. Made for Dar es Salaam heat.

products.name: 9PM Elixir
products.description: The extrait: 9PM deepened into cardamom and benzoin, in a burgundy bottle built for the night.

products.name: Supremacy Not Only Intense
products.description: Saffron and rose over a smooth ambergris base. Confidence in an extrait — our most gifted Afnan.

products.name: Supremacy Silver
products.description: Radiant grapefruit and pink pepper over vetiver: charm in a silver flacon.

products.name: Turathi Blue
products.description: A rich, recognisable blue fragrance — citrus and lavender on ambery woods, in an art-deco flacon.

products.name: Rare Carbon
products.description: Leather, violet leaf and cinnamon carved into a sophisticated masculine — the sculpted black bottle says it all.

products.name: Historic Olmeda
products.description: A touch of the past with a modern twist: saffron, incense and oud in a tasselled bottle.

products.name: Amber Wood
products.description: Lavender melting into cedar and warm amber. Ajmal’s modern signature — warm, clean and endlessly wearable.

products.name: Amber Wood Noir
products.description: The darker sibling: saffron and oud over the Amber Wood base, in a black textured flacon.

products.name: Wisal Dhahab
products.description: Golden fruit and honey over an oud-musk base — a spellbinding oriental in a jewel-like gold bottle.

products.name: Aristocrat Platinum
products.description: Crisp citrus and lavender with a platinum polish. The Aristocrat for the boardroom.

products.name: Evoke Gold Edition
products.description: Golden fruit and soft florals over vanilla, in a sculpted gold bottle with a rose cap. A gift that lands every time.

products.name: Evoke Gold for Men
products.description: Aromatic spice and woods in the gold Evoke flacon. Bright by day, warm by night.

products.name: Shadow Ice
products.description: A frosted, minty freshness in a faceted ice-blue bottle — Ajmal’s answer to the blue fragrance.

products.name: Dahn Al Oudh Majd
products.description: Pure, aged dahn al oudh in a 3ml crystal vial. This is the raw material behind everything else in the shop — one drop is a ceremony.
